question: GQ-006
finding: The people graph had NO vault backup. The passage index had one; the graph six claims ground in did not.
action: sqlite3 .backup to vault (WAL database — cp would tear it), verified table by table
prose_correction: I have repeatedly written '463,230 content edges' for the people graph. That is the GitHub-domain SUBSET. The table holds 564,579. The observatory published the correct total the whole time; my prose was quoting a filtered count as if it were the whole graph.
